socCode.title: SOC code (for a single occupation)
socCode.description: Leave the Occupations (multiple) field below empty to use this single-lookup shortcut instead. The 6-digit Standard Occupational Classification code, e.g. "15-1252" (find yours at bls.gov/soc). "15-1252.00" works too.

stateCode.title: State code (optional, for a single occupation)
stateCode.description: State for state-level data, as a two-letter code ("TX") or a name ("Texas"). Omit for national data. Only used together with SOC code above.

occupations.title: Occupations (multiple)
occupations.description: For looking up several occupations in one run instead of one at a time. One entry per occupation: { "socCode": "15-1252", "stateCode"?: "TX" }, or just a list of codes like ["15-1252", "29-1141"]. An entry that can't be looked up comes back with an error and isn't charged. Ignored if SOC code above is filled in.

apiKey.title: BLS API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional free registration key from bls.gov/developers, raises the daily request limit and historical range. Not required for small batches.
